name: ZERO_DISCOVERY
description: Spatial query for an analyte in a county with 0 monitoring stations. Must emit 0-station discovery plan without retrying or hallucinating stations.
query: Where is nitrate monitored in Dare County, NC?

name: MISSING_GEO
description: Spatial query without geographic constraint. Must NOT query all national stations; must trigger clarification.
query: Where is streamflow monitored?

name: MODALITY_COLLISION
description: Streamflow request at a specific station. Must route to continuous daily endpoint, not lab samples /results/narrow.
query: Show me streamflow at USGS-02087500

name: MULTI_PCODE_EXPANSION
description: Discrete family query for calcium. Must expand into 4 constituent codes with 00915 primary, without duplicate counting.
query: How many calcium records are at USGS-0423205010?

name: FRACTION_DISAMBIGUATION
description: Specific fraction query (filtered orthophosphate). Must resolve to dissolved codes, excluding unfiltered codes.
query: Show me filtered orthophosphate at USGS-0423205010

name: INVALID_STATION_ID
description: Station query for a non-existent station ID. Must plan correctly and fail fast with clean 404 handling.
query: What is measured at USGS-00000000?

name: MULTIPLE_CANDIDATES
description: County query without state disambiguation (Orange County exists across multiple states). Must clarify state.
query: Where is nitrate monitored in Orange County?

name: NO_PARAMETER
description: Broad request for measurements at a station without specifying a parameter. Must route to station_inventory or clarify parameter.
query: Show me measurements at USGS-02087500

name: TOOL_FAILURE
description: Upstream service returns 503/429/timeout. Circuit breaker trips and returns a friendly outage response.
query: Show me calcium readings at USGS-0423205010

name: TEMPORAL_RANGE_MONTH_YEAR
description: Explicit month-year range must extract partial ISO bounds into temporal without computing day-of-month end dates or putting dates in filters.
query: Can you retrieve records of dissolved oxygen available between January 2020 and July 2023 at USGS-02087500?

name: TEMPORAL_SINGLE_YEAR
description: Single calendar year must extract start='2021', end='2021' in temporal.
query: Show me streamflow at USGS-02087500 in 2021.

name: TEMPORAL_OPEN_START_SINCE
description: Open-ended 'since 2020' must extract start='2020' (or relative='since', year=2020) in temporal.
query: How many phosphorus records at USGS-0423205010 since 2020?

name: TEMPORAL_MONTH_AND_YEAR
description: Specific month and year ('in March 2021') must extract month=3, year=2021 in temporal.
query: Show me calcium values at USGS-0423205010 in March 2021.

name: TEMPORAL_MONTH_NO_YEAR
description: Month without a year ('during the month of March') must extract month=3 without inventing a year.
query: Can you summarize how many records of pH are available during the month of March at USGS-02087500?

name: TEMPORAL_WINTER_SINGLE_YEAR
description: 'winter 2022' must extract season='winter', year=2022.
query: How many organic carbon records at USGS-02087500 in winter 2022?

name: TEMPORAL_WINTER_SPAN_YEAR
description: 'winter 2022-23' must extract season='winter', year=2023 (year of its January).
query: Show me mean daily streamflow at USGS-02087500 for winter 2022-23.

name: TEMPORAL_SEASON_NO_YEAR
description: Season without year ('during the winter') must extract season='winter' without inventing a year.
query: Can you summarize how many records of carbon are available during the winter at USGS-02087500?

name: TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_LAST_SEASON
description: 'last winter' must extract season='winter', relative='last'.
query: Show me nitrate readings at USGS-02087500 from last winter.

name: TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_LAST_MONTH
description: 'last March' must extract month=3, relative='last'.
query: Show me streamflow at USGS-02087500 during last March.

name: TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_THIS_YEAR
description: 'this year' must extract relative='this', unit='year'.
query: How many nitrate records at USGS-02087500 this year?

name: TEMPORAL_RELATIVE_PAST_N_YEARS
description: 'past 5 years' must extract relative='past', unit='year', n=5.
query: Show me mean daily streamflow at USGS-02087500 over the past 5 years.
